data.gender_notes: Nusaimah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Nusaimah means 'giver of good news'. This name is derived from the root 'nasa' which signifies 'to give good news'. It is a name that evokes positivity and hope. The name Nusaimah carries the meaning “Deliverer of good news” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nusaimah usually hope their child will grow to embody deliverer of good news and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nusaimah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

Similarly, the name Nusaimah implies someone who is always spreading positivity and joy, which is a highly valued trait in any culture.

He brought the message of peace, hope and love to the world, and his words brought solace and comfort to millions. The name Nusaimah signifies someone who carries this prophetic legacy, inspiring hope, positivity and peace in others. It is a name that symbolizes the spirit of many meaningful, comforting, and spiritually uplifting messages of the Islamic faith.
